card.name: Words just before "history"
card.fires_on: The word right before "history" in patient-history phrases, such as "medical" in "medical history", "personal" in "personal or family history", and "a" in "patients with a history of".

modes.label: Medical or personal
modes.description: An adjective that leads into "history" when describing a patient's background.
modes.example: Your doctor will ask about your symptoms and<< medical>> history.

modes.label: Article after "with"
modes.description: The word "a" after "patients with" or "individuals with", just before "history of".
